visualMaster.rule: Do not infer page-specific geometry, module bundling or styling from prose. Review the actual user-provided page image and complete both visual-review passes before locking.

requiredAfterVisualReview: constraintLevel and tolerance per major object
photo masks, face-safe zones and replaceability

passBChecks: which short fixed text/background/icon groups are one bundled display object
whether any photo proxy would contain page decoration
reviewProcess.lockCondition: Do not set VISUAL_MASTER_LOCKED until both passes are complete and all findings plus display-module/proxy classifications are corrected in this manifest.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Identify short fixed display objects that visually move as one unit and may be generated as one complete asset including text/numbers/background/icons/accents. Visible fixed text need not remain editable. Do not bake long, personal, TBD or frequently changing copy. Do not invent the target list before reviewing P04.png.

photoPolicy.rule: Every real-photo slot must be a separate clipped/masked replaceable image. Use only clean standalone real/representative photos with no P04 page background, title, border, stickers, route, frames or decorations baked in. Face/eye safety overrides TARGET geometry when necessary.

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P04.png used as a photo fill
page screenshot used as photo proxy
generic editable Figma primitives replacing a visually authored fixed display module solely for editability
fixed display module flattening a replaceable real photo

qa.gate0: Pending direct visual review of actual page master plus second-pass reverse omission audit.
